title: 01 · 从分组检查开始
01 · Check the assignment first
text:
芯片中的单元是节点，单元之间的连接是边。把单元分到不同区域后，跨区域连线会消耗布线资源。我们先用一个简化模型衡量这项代价：无向边的权重表示切开这条连接的成本。它不是完整的布线长度或时序模型，却能让我们明确比较同一模型下的分组。

一个二分必须让每个节点恰好出现一次，两侧都非空。漏掉 C、把 C 同时放进两侧、把所有节点都塞到左侧，都不是本课程接受的二分。检查输入和分组应先于计算指标；否则漏分的节点可能被当成一个新组，得到一个看似合理的错误数字。

公共图 G01 有 A、B、C、D、E 五个节点，边为 AB:5、AC:1、BC:4、CD:2、CE:1、DE:5。每条边只列一次，所有节点默认面积为 1。后面六章仍使用这张图，让算法的区别不被样例的变化掩盖。

Represent circuit cells by vertices and connections by undirected edges. An edge weight models the cost of placing its endpoints in different regions. This is a deliberately simple model: it does not predict complete routed wire length or timing. It does let us compare assignments under a clearly defined objective.

A bisection assigns every vertex exactly once and leaves both sides nonempty. Omitting C, placing C on both sides, or putting everything on the left is invalid here. Validate before measuring. Otherwise a missing label can accidentally behave like an extra part and produce a plausible but meaningless number.

The shared graph G01 has vertices A–E and edges AB:5, AC:1, BC:4, CD:2, CE:1 and DE:5. Every edge appears once and every vertex initially has size 1. The later lessons reuse this graph so that differences in algorithms are visible without changing the input.

title: 02 · 一条边只算一次
02 · Count each crossing edge once
text:
割代价定义为 cut = Σ w(u,v)·[part(u) ≠ part(v)]。方括号在条件成立时为 1，否则为 0。判断依据是两端是否异组，不是这条线在屏幕上是否穿过某个框，也不是它是否与其他线相交。

把 AE 放左边、BCD 放右边，跨边为 AB、AC、CE、DE，cut = 5+1+1+5 = 12。请逐条复核：D 在右、E 在左，DE 跨组；C 在右、E 在左，CE 也跨组。CD 两端同在右侧，不应计入。逐边核对比凭图形印象凑出一个和更可靠。

改成 ABC | DE 后，只有 CD 和 CE 跨组，cut = 2+1 = 3。两种方案的人数都是 2 与 3，但割代价相差 9。平衡相同不代表连接质量相同。试着点击下面的节点换侧，观察切边清单随哪一个决定而变化。

[[interactive]]

The objective is cut = Σ w(u,v)·[part(u) ≠ part(v)]. The bracket is 1 when its condition is true and 0 otherwise. Endpoint labels determine whether an edge crosses. Its position on the screen, or an intersection with another drawn line, has no effect.

For AE | BCD, the crossing edges are AB, AC, CE and DE: 5+1+1+5 = 12. CD does not cross because both endpoints are on the right. For ABC | DE, only CD and CE cross, giving 2+1 = 3. Both assignments have side counts 2 and 3, yet their costs differ by 9. Equal balance does not mean equal connection quality.

Click a vertex in the embedded experiment to move it. Before doing so, predict which incident edges will enter or leave the cut. The highlighted edges and their explicit sum are the explanation of the new result.

title: 03 · 人数、面积与容量
03 · Counts, areas and capacities
text:
默认每个节点 size=1 时，节点数与面积和相同。把 A 的面积改成 4，就不再如此：ABC 的人数仍是 3，面积却是 6；DE 的人数和面积都是 2。容量 C=4 时，ABC | DE 虽然 cut 只有 3，仍然放不下。

本课程显式报告 counts 和 areas。KL 交换一左一右，保持每侧节点数；如果两点面积不同，交换后面积仍会改变。FM 基础实验也按节点数差约束合法性。多路划分的 capacity 则按面积和检查。读一项“平衡”结论时，必须同时读它使用的量和阈值。

若总面积为 S、每组容量为 C，那么至少需要 ceil(S/C) 个组。这是必要条件，不是一般的充分条件。例如面积 3、3、3 放进两个容量 5 的组，总容量 10 大于总面积 9，但任何两个节点都无法同组，实际上需要三个组。

When every size equals 1, counts and areas coincide. Change A's size to 4: ABC still contains three vertices, but its area becomes 6; DE has count and area 2. Under capacity 4, ABC | DE has a low cut of 3 but is infeasible.

The course reports counts and areas separately. KL exchanges one vertex from each side, preserving counts; unequal vertex sizes can still change the areas. The basic FM lab also constrains count difference. The k-way capacity parameter instead constrains area. A balance claim needs both its measurement and its threshold.

Total area S and capacity C imply at least ceil(S/C) parts. This is necessary, not sufficient. Three vertices of area 3 cannot fit into two parts of capacity 5, even though total capacity 10 exceeds total area 9: no pair of these vertices can share a part.

title: 04 · 两个平衡指标
04 · Two balance summaries
text:
对二分的面积 s0、s1，本课程使用 ratio = min(s0,s1)/max(s0,s1)，越接近 1 越均衡；imbalance = |s0−s1|/(s0+s1)，越接近 0 越均衡。公共图 2 对 3 的 ratio 为 2/3，imbalance 为 1/5。它们数值不同，不能用同一阈值互换。

空组会得到 ratio=0，但我们仍把它标成不可行。指标函数既返回数值，也返回 nonempty 与 feasible。这样可以保留诊断信息，同时避免把“cut=0”的全塞一侧方案误判为优秀答案。

对 k 路，页面仍显示各组面积，以及最小/最大面积比和极差/总面积。这里是教学用的描述量，不把它冒称为论文里任何一种归一化 cut。比较两个结果前，先确认 k、面积定义和容量一致。

For side areas s0 and s1, ratio = min(s0,s1)/max(s0,s1), where values closer to 1 are more even. Imbalance = |s0−s1|/(s0+s1), where values closer to 0 are more even. For areas 2 and 3 the values are 2/3 and 1/5. Their thresholds are not interchangeable.

An empty side has ratio 0, but is still infeasible. The evaluator returns numerical diagnostics alongside nonempty and feasible flags. This prevents an all-on-one-side assignment with cut 0 from looking like a successful answer.

For k parts, the interface shows every area plus the minimum/maximum ratio and range/total summary. These are descriptive teaching metrics, not an unstated normalized-cut objective. Compare results only after aligning k, sizes and capacity.

title: 05 · 先判合法，再谈目标
05 · Feasibility precedes optimization
text:
优化问题包含目标和约束。目标是减小 cut；约束是完整互斥、非空和约定的平衡或容量。先在合法解集合中筛选，再比较目标。把非法方案与合法方案混排，会奖励规避约束的结果。

若两个合法方案 cut 相同，可以进一步报告面积分布，但不要悄悄加入一个未声明的新目标。后续算法的平票规则都明确写出，例如同增益时按节点名排序。这能保证课堂演示、练习答案和自动测试可复现。

本章是评价器，不会自动寻找最优划分。下面实验中的节点换侧由你决定；算法章节才会产生候选与自动决策。小图精确枚举可帮助校准，却不能说明一种启发式在大图上也总能找到最优。

An optimization problem has an objective and constraints. Here the objective minimizes cut; constraints require a complete, disjoint, nonempty assignment and the declared balance or capacity. Filter for legality before comparing costs. Mixing illegal and legal assignments rewards avoiding the problem's rules.

If legal assignments tie on cut, report their distributions without silently adding a new objective. Later engines also state tie rules, such as vertex-name order. Those rules make experiments, challenge answers and tests reproducible.

This lesson evaluates assignments; it does not automatically optimize them. You choose each move in the lab. Later lessons introduce algorithmic decisions. A tiny exact oracle can calibrate an example, but does not establish a general optimality guarantee for a heuristic.

title: 06 · 写一个可靠的评价器
06 · Implement a reliable evaluator
text:
实现时先验证节点唯一、面积为正、边端点存在、权重有效，再验证 assignment 对所有节点给出合法组号。无向图的邻接表常把一条边存两次；若直接遍历邻接表求和，需要去重。本课程规范化后的 edges 列表每条边只有一项，因此直接累加即可。

```python
cost = 0
for u, v, w in edges:
    if assignment[u] != assignment[v]:
        cost += w
```

用三个性质检查实现：交换组号不会改变 cut；所有边权乘 c 后 cut 也乘 c；在固定分组下，把一条跨边权重增加 Δ，cut 恰好增加 Δ。这样的检查比只记住 G01 的答案更能发现错误。

Validate unique vertex names, positive sizes, existing endpoints and finite weights. Then verify that the assignment supplies a valid part for every vertex. An adjacency list often stores each undirected edge twice. Summing it directly double-counts; the normalized edge list used here stores each edge once.

```python
cost = 0
for u, v, w in edges:
    if assignment[u] != assignment[v]:
        cost += w
```

Test properties, not just the remembered answer 3. Renaming the parts leaves cut unchanged. Multiplying every weight by c multiplies cut by c. Increasing one crossing edge by Δ increases cut by exactly Δ. These checks expose errors that a single fixture can miss.

title: 07 · 带着契约进入下一章
07 · Carry the contract forward
text:
接下来先构造初始二分，再用 KL/FM 改进，随后学习谱排序、递归二分和多路比较。每种方法输出不同的决策过程，但都回到本章的评价器。实验台允许回退到任一事件；指标总是对应当前图上显示的分组。

完成本章时，你应能解释一个 cut 来自哪些边，指出当前平衡按人数还是面积计算，并拒绝一个低 cut 却违反容量的方案。请先做挑战题，再到 Python 区实现 cut_cost 与 group_loads；通过检查后，页面会显示你自己的函数算出的结果。

Next we construct an initial split, refine with KL and FM, then study spectral ordering, recursive bisection and k-way comparisons. Their decision processes differ, but all use this evaluator. When you rewind the lab, the displayed metrics describe the currently selected state.

Before leaving, explain the edges behind a cut, identify whether a balance rule uses counts or areas, and reject a low-cost assignment that exceeds capacity. Attempt the challenges, then implement cut_cost and group_loads in the Python lab. Its output is calculated by your functions.

title: 01 · 构造一个起点
01 · Construct a starting point
text:
初始二分回答“从哪里开始”。它从图和明确的人数目标出发，给所有节点贴上 0 或 1 的标签。KL/FM 则从已有分组出发尝试改进。不要把构造中的临时状态，当成改进算法每一步都必须满足的最终解。

本章统一要求最终人数为 floor(n/2) 与 ceil(n/2)，面积只作诊断。三种方法共享这个输出契约，但过程不同。锚点取按名称排序后的第一个节点；图中平票按名字处理。算法简单，规则却需要写全，才能复现实验。

Initial bisection answers where to start. It builds an assignment from the graph; KL and FM instead refine an existing assignment. Temporary construction states should not be confused with the final contract.

All three methods finish with floor(n/2) vertices on the left and ceil(n/2) on the right. Areas are diagnostics. The first vertex in name order is the anchor and equal scores use name order. These decisions make the simple algorithms reproducible.

title: 02 · 有种子的随机基线
02 · A seeded random baseline
text:
随机法先用整数 seed 产生一个确定的伪随机序列，再用 Fisher–Yates 洗牌。洗牌后前 floor(n/2) 个节点去左侧，其余去右侧。它不是逐点抛硬币，因此不会随机产生空侧或违反最终人数目标。

同一个输入、同一个种子和同一个伪随机生成器产生同一结果。仅说“seed=7”还不足以跨语言复现；必须连生成器与洗牌规则一起说明。本课程浏览器使用 mulberry32，Python 小实验聚焦确定性生长，不假定 Python random 与 JavaScript 等价。

随机法适合作为基线，也可运行多个种子比较结果分布。只挑出最好的那一次却不报告尝试次数，会高估它的稳定性。它没有看边权，因而没有理由保证割代价较小。

The random method uses an integer seed and Fisher–Yates shuffle, then assigns the first floor(n/2) shuffled vertices to the left. Unlike independent coin flips, this guarantees the final counts and avoids empty sides.

Reproducibility requires the generator and shuffle rule as well as the seed. This browser uses mulberry32. The Python exercise focuses on deterministic growing; it does not assume Python random matches JavaScript.

Try several seeds and report the distribution or the number of attempts. Selecting only the best seed without reporting the budget exaggerates reliability. Random construction ignores edge weights, so it has no low-cut guarantee.

title: 03 · 顺序贪心的增量
03 · Incremental greedy placement
text:
贪心法先把锚点放左，再按名字处理其他节点。对当前节点 v，分别计算它放入左右侧时，与已分配节点之间新增的跨边权重。超过目标人数的侧先排除，然后选择增量更小的合法侧；增量相同优先当前人数较少的一侧，再取较小组号。

公共图从 A 在左开始。处理 B 时，放左新增 0，放右新增 5，因此 B 去左；左侧目标人数 2 已满，C、D、E 随后必须去右。最终 AB | CDE 的 cut 为 AC+BC=5。这个局部选择没有保证后面的连接也好。

实验台的候选表给出当前决定使用的增量，图上的总 cut 则按一个完整临时标签计算。贪心尚未处理的节点暂画在右侧；事件中的 placed 清单明确指出哪些节点已参与本次增量评分。不要把临时图的 cut 与候选增量混为一谈。

Place the anchor on the left, then process remaining vertices in name order. For each legal side, sum the new crossing weight to already placed vertices. Discard full sides first. Choose smaller increment, then smaller current count, then smaller side number.

In G01, after A goes left, B costs 0 on the left or 5 on the right. B goes left, filling its target of 2. C, D and E must go right. The final cut of AB | CDE is AC+BC=5. The decision was locally sensible, but did not optimize future connections.

The candidate table reports the increment used for selection. The graph shows a complete temporary assignment, drawing unprocessed vertices on the right. The placed list identifies which vertices contributed to the score. A temporary total cut is not the same quantity as a placement increment.

title: 04 · 区域生长
04 · Region growing
text:
生长法也从 A 出发，但下一步不按名字固定处理节点。它给每个未加入左侧的节点打分：该节点与当前左侧所有节点的边权之和。取最高分，平票取名字小的节点，直到左侧有 floor(n/2) 个节点；其余统一去右。

G01 第一步的候选分数为 B:5、C:1、D:0、E:0，因此吸收 B 后停止，仍得到 AB | CDE，cut=5。它与顺序贪心在这张图上相同，不表示两个算法相同。换一张图或改变锚点，选点顺序可能明显不同。

[[interactive]]

Starting at A, growing scores every unselected vertex by its total connection weight to the current left side. Pick the maximum, breaking ties by name, until the left side reaches floor(n/2). All remaining vertices form the right side.

The first G01 scores are B:5, C:1, D:0, E:0. Adding B completes the left side and again gives cut 5. Agreement on this graph does not make growing and sequential greedy the same algorithm. A different graph or anchor can change their orders.

title: 05 · 把平票和容量写进算法
05 · Specify ties and limits
text:
“把联系最紧的点放一起”不是可执行规格：联系指单条边、总和还是平均？吸收左侧还是两侧轮流？满了以后怎么办？一个平票会改变之后所有候选分数，因此规则不是无关紧要的细节。

当节点面积不相等，人数目标仍然不会自动保证面积平衡。若你要把本章改成面积容量构造器，需要重新定义合法候选与无法继续时的状态，不能只把显示标签从“人数”换成“面积”。

“Keep strongly connected vertices together” is not an executable specification. Does strength mean a single edge, a sum or an average? Which side grows? What happens when it is full? A tie affects later scores and therefore matters.

Unequal areas break the correspondence between count targets and area balance. An area-constrained constructor needs its own candidate rules and failure state. Relabeling a count as an area does not implement that change.

title: 06 · 比较起点的方式
06 · Compare starts fairly
text:
先固定图、节点顺序、人数目标和平票规则，再比较 cut。随机方法还需记录种子与运行次数。然后将各起点送入同一个改进器，观察最终 cut 和改进路径；这能区分“起点本身好”与“起点容易被后续方法修好”。

本课程的比较页使用相同 G01，并在每行显示方法的约束。相同结果只支持这个具体样例的结论。想比较稳定性，需要一组有代表性的图、明确的预算和每次运行的完整记录。

Fix the graph, order, count targets and tie rules. Record seeds and run budgets for random methods. You can then feed the different starts into the same refiner, separating a good initial cut from a starting point that is easy to improve.

The comparison page uses one graph and states every row's contract. An equal result supports only a conclusion about that example. Claims about reliability require a representative graph collection and a declared computational budget.

title: 07 · 实现与检查
07 · Implement and check
text:
Python 区实现 grow_order 和 balanced_initial：前者返回从锚点开始的完整生长顺序，后者按给定顺序取前 floor(n/2) 个节点作为左侧。检查包括平票、断连图、奇偶节点数和不重复不遗漏。

本章停止条件是达到指定人数，或所有节点已处理。它不会因为当前 cut 不再下降就提前停止。下一章将在完整分组上计算成对交换增益，保留本章输出作为可复现的起点。

Implement grow_order to return the full anchored growing order, then balanced_initial to assign its first floor(n/2) vertices left. Tests cover ties, disconnected graphs, odd and even sizes, uniqueness and completeness.

Construction stops when its target count is reached or all vertices have been processed. It does not stop just because the current cut fails to improve. The next lesson computes swap gains on a complete starting assignment.

title: 01 · 用一对交换保持人数
01 · Preserve counts with a pair
text:
KL 从一个完整二分出发，每次从两侧各选一个未锁定节点交换。因此两侧节点数始终不变，但面积可能改变。公共图起点 AE | BCD 的 cut 为 12；想知道哪一对值得交换，先把每个节点对 cut 的局部影响算清楚。

外部边是通向异侧的边，内部边通向同侧。定义 D(v)=external(v)−internal(v)。若只移动一个节点，这就是 cut 的下降量，但 KL 同时移动两个节点，不能直接把两个 D 相加。

KL starts from a complete split and exchanges one unlocked vertex from each side. Counts remain fixed; areas need not. Our initial AE | BCD assignment has cut 12. To rank exchanges, first measure each vertex's local contribution.

Let D(v)=external(v)−internal(v). External edges lead to the other side, internal edges to the same side. D is the gain of moving one vertex, but a pair exchange needs a correction.

title: 02 · 成对增益为何要减两次边权
02 · The pair-gain correction
text:
交换异侧 a、b 的增益为 g(a,b)=D(a)+D(b)−2w(a,b)。若两点之间没有边，w=0。直接相加两个 D 时，a–b 这条原本跨组的边会被当成两次“移除”；实际交换后它仍然跨组，所以必须减去 2w。

在 AE | BCD 中，D(A)=6，D(E)=6，D(B)=1，D(C)=−2，D(D)=3。候选 A↔D 的增益为 6+3−0=9，交换后得到 DE | ABC，cut=3。请用另一种方法复核：复制分组、实际交换，再计算 cut_before−cut_after，应与公式完全一致。

[[interactive]]

For opposite-side a and b, g(a,b)=D(a)+D(b)−2w(a,b). Use zero when no edge joins them. Adding the D values counts the a–b edge as removed twice. In reality, after swapping both endpoints it remains crossing, so subtract 2w.

For AE | BCD, D(A)=6, D(E)=6, D(B)=1, D(C)=−2 and D(D)=3. A↔D gains 6+3=9 and produces DE | ABC with cut 3. Independently verify the formula by copying the assignment, exchanging the pair and recomputing cut_before−cut_after.

[[interactive]]

title: 03 · 锁定不是立即接受
03 · Locking is not acceptance
text:
选出最大增益候选后，先在试探分组中交换并锁住两点。本 pass 后续不能再选择它们。然后在新的试探分组上更新 D 值和候选。若多对增益相同，按 a、b 的名称排序；候选的 a 总来自当前 0 侧。

试探过程仍然继续，即便下一步增益为负。公共图第一步增益 9，第二步增益 −8；相应累计增益为 9、1。第二步使 cut 从 3 回升到 11，但这不是最终接受结果。实验台用事件类型明确区分 trial-swap 与 best-prefix。

After selecting the highest-gain pair, exchange it in the trial assignment and lock both vertices. Recompute candidates on that trial state. Equal gains use a then b in name order, with a drawn from the current side 0.

Continue even when the next gain is negative. G01's first pass has gains 9 and −8, with cumulative gains 9 and 1. The second trial raises cut from 3 to 11. This is not the accepted result. The lab distinguishes trial-swap from best-prefix events.

title: 04 · 最佳前缀与回退
04 · Best prefix and rollback
text:
给增益序列 g1…gm 加上空前缀 G0=0，再计算 Gk=Σi≤k gi。选择累计增益最大的最早 k。若最大值不大于 0，就保留空前缀，不改变 pass 起点。不要选择单步增益最大的那一步，也不要只保留所有正增益动作后拼接成一个不存在的过程。

G01 的序列 [9,−8] 对应前缀 [0,9,1]，最佳 k=1。因此从 pass 起点重新执行第一对交换，撤销其后的试探，接受 cut=3。页面的前缀图和当前分组一起回退，避免只更新数值却没恢复标签。

一个更能说明“负增益仍值得试探”的序列是 [−2,5,−1]：最佳前缀长度为 2，总增益为 3。这里第一步必须先变差，后面才可能变好。这个算术例子只解释前缀选择，不冒充 G01 的实际轨迹。

Include G0=0, the empty prefix, then compute Gk=Σi≤k gi. Choose the earliest prefix with maximum cumulative gain. If no positive cumulative gain exists, retain the empty prefix. Do not pick the largest individual gain or splice together positive moves while skipping their intervening states.

The G01 prefix values are [0,9,1], so retain one exchange. Reapply that prefix from the pass start and discard later trials, accepting cut 3. The graph and metrics must roll back together.

For the illustrative arithmetic sequence [−2,5,−1], the best prefix has length 2 and gain 3. An initially harmful move can lead to a useful sequence. This sequence explains prefix selection; it is not claimed to be a G01 trace.

title: 05 · 多个 pass 与停止条件
05 · Passes and termination
text:
接受最佳前缀后，解除锁定并从接受分组开始下一个 pass。若下一轮最佳前缀为空，就按“无正累计增益”停止；达到 pass 上限则报告 limit。二者不能都显示为“已找到最优”。

KL 搜索的是特定成对交换与前缀策略能发现的改进，不保证全局最小 cut。即便小图精确枚举与它结果相同，也只能说明这一实例吻合。它还保持初始人数，如果起点人数本来不符合需求，成对交换无法修正人数目标。

Unlock vertices and begin the next pass from the accepted assignment. Stop when the empty prefix wins. If the configured pass limit is reached, report limit instead. Neither status establishes a global optimum.

KL explores improvements found by its pair-and-prefix strategy. Matching a tiny exact optimum on one graph does not prove a general guarantee. Because counts stay fixed, pair swaps also cannot repair an inappropriate initial count target.

title: 06 · 核对实现的四个不变量
06 · Four implementation invariants
text:
每次试探后检查：左右节点数不变；锁定节点不重复；实际 cut 差等于记录增益；累计增益等于 pass 起点 cut 减当前试探 cut。接受前缀后，cut 应等于起点 cut 减最佳累计增益，并且不能高于起点。

```text
repeat a pass:
    trial ← accepted; unlock all
    choose best unlocked cross pair
    swap in trial; lock both; record gain
    repeat until one side has no unlocked vertex
    accept earliest maximum positive prefix
stop when the empty prefix is best
```

教学引擎每次枚举未锁定跨侧点对并重新计算候选，便于审查。不要把这一实现的运行时间当成所有 KL 工程实现的性能结论。

After every trial, verify fixed side counts, no repeated locked vertices, actual cut difference equal to recorded gain, and cumulative gain equal to start cut minus current trial cut. After acceptance, cut must equal start cut minus best cumulative gain and cannot be worse than the pass start.

```text
repeat a pass:
    trial ← accepted; unlock all
    choose best unlocked cross pair
    swap in trial; lock both; record gain
    repeat until one side has no unlocked vertex
    accept earliest maximum positive prefix
stop when the empty prefix is best
```

The teaching engine enumerates candidate pairs for transparency. Its runtime should not be generalized to every engineered KL implementation.

title: 07 · 与 FM 的关系
07 · How FM differs
text:
KL 与 FM 都有试探、锁定和最佳前缀。差别不是“KL 只接受单步改进，FM 才允许变差”；完整 KL 同样允许负增益试探。主要差别是一次移动的对象、平衡检查和候选维护。

Python 区实现 pair_gain 与 best_prefix。检查会把公式与实际交换后的 cut 比较，并测试空前缀、全负增益和平票时最早前缀。下一章会看到一个收益最高的节点，因为移动后人数不合法而必须等待。

Both KL and FM use trials, locks and a best prefix. It is incorrect to say that only FM tolerates worsening trials. Their important differences concern the moving object, legality checks and candidate maintenance.

Implement pair_gain and best_prefix in Python. Checks compare the formula with an actual swap and cover empty, all-negative and tied-prefix cases. Next, FM shows why the highest-gain vertex may have to wait for a legal move.

title: 01 · 单点移动的吸引力
01 · Why move one vertex?
text:
FM 每次只移动一个节点，候选数量更少，也便于用 net 的 pin 计数维护增益。不过单点移动会改变人数，因此必须把平衡写进候选合法性。基础实验要求两侧非空且 |n0−n1|≤maxDiff，默认 maxDiff=1。

从 G01 的 AE | BCD 出发，人数为 2 与 3。A 和 E 的单点增益都为 6，却会把人数变成 1 与 4，不合法。D 的增益为 3，移动后人数为 3 与 2，合法。正确的第一步是 D，而不是收益最高的 A。

FM tries one vertex at a time, reducing the candidate set and enabling gain maintenance through net pin counts. A move changes side counts, so balance must be part of legality. The basic lab requires nonempty sides and |n0−n1|≤maxDiff, initially 1.

For AE | BCD, counts are 2 and 3. A and E both have gain 6, but either move produces counts 1 and 4 and is illegal. D has gain 3 and produces counts 3 and 2. D is the correct first choice.

title: 02 · 先过滤，再排序
02 · Filter before ranking
text:
对每个未锁定节点，先假设它换侧，检查移动后的非空与人数差。只有合法节点才进入选择集合；在其中选最大增益，平票按名字。候选面板保留不合法节点及其原因，帮助你看到被约束排除的高分方案。

移动 D 后，分组为 ADE | BC，cut=9。此时 A 再移动就得到 DE | ABC，人数 2 与 3，合法，增益为 6，因此 cut 降到 3。合法性依赖当前状态；第一步不合法的节点，第二步可能变合法。

[[interactive]]

For each unlocked vertex, check the assignment after its hypothetical move. Rank only legal candidates, using maximum gain then name order. The table retains blocked candidates and the reason they were excluded.

Moving D gives ADE | BC and cut 9. A can now move legally, giving DE | ABC, counts 2 and 3, and gain 6. Legality changes with the state: a blocked first move may become legal later.

[[interactive]]

title: 03 · 从边到 net 的增益
03 · Gains for edges and nets
text:
对普通边，单点增益等于外部边权减内部边权。对一条多引脚 net，cut-net 模型只问它是否同时跨两侧，整条 net 的权重只计一次，不能用任意两两边展开后仍声称目标不变。

设 F 是节点原侧、T 是目标侧。若一条 net 在 F 侧只有该节点一个 pin，移动后这条 net 不再跨侧，增益加 w；若 T 侧原来没有 pin，移动会使 net 开始跨侧，增益减 w。对每条相邻 net 累加这两种条件，就是 FS/TE 规则。

课程共享实验输入仍是普通图，每条边可视为两 pin 的 net。底层 FM 引擎保留 net 计数与受影响节点增益更新，以便检验原理；界面不会把尚未开放的超图输入当成已有功能。

For ordinary edges, gain is external minus internal weight. In a cut-net hypergraph model, a multi-pin net contributes its weight once whenever pins occupy both sides. Replacing it with pairwise edges generally changes the objective.

Let F be the vertex's current side and T its destination. If the vertex is the only F-side pin of a net, its move removes that net from the cut: add w. If T has no pin, the move makes the net cross: subtract w. Sum these FS/TE contributions over incident nets.

The shared interface accepts ordinary graphs, treating edges as two-pin nets. The underlying FM engine maintains net counts and updates affected gains. The interface does not claim to expose a hypergraph editor that has not been implemented.

title: 04 · 负增益、锁定与最佳前缀
04 · Trials, locks and the best prefix
text:
每次试探后锁定节点，本 pass 不得再移动。增益必须基于新状态更新，不能沿用初始排序。没有合法未锁定节点时，结束当前试探序列，再在包含空前缀的累计增益中选择最佳前缀。

G01 第一轮的最佳前缀是 D、A 两步，累计增益 9，接受 cut=3。后续试探可能变差，但不会改变“最终仅接受最佳前缀”的规则。实验中的锁定名单、候选合法性和前缀数据都是引擎实际计算的状态。

如果 maxDiff=0 且两侧人数相等，任何单点移动都会打破严格相等。FM 会没有合法单点可选；KL 的成对交换仍可能继续。这是邻域和约束共同造成的停滞，不是证明当前已经全局最优。

Lock each tried vertex until the next pass. Update gains after the move instead of reusing the initial ranking. When no legal unlocked vertex remains, choose the best cumulative prefix, including the empty prefix.

G01's best first-pass prefix moves D then A, gains 9 in total, and accepts cut 3. Later trials may worsen the state; they do not alter the acceptance rule. The candidate, lock and prefix panels show computed engine state.

If maxDiff=0 with equal counts, every single move breaks equality. FM has no legal move, while KL pair exchanges can still proceed. This is a consequence of the neighborhood and constraint, not a certificate of global optimality.

title: 05 · 面积平衡需要另一套检查
05 · Area balance is a separate rule
text:
本基础 FM 按人数差约束，而不是按节点面积。即使人数合法，一侧面积仍可能很大。要加入面积界限，必须在每个候选移动后重新检查面积，并让起点合法；只改变结果表中的单位没有实现这个约束。

实验允许你改变人数差窗口。窗口放宽后，某个高增益节点可能提前进入合法集；窗口收紧后，也可能根本没有可用起点。后者显示 invalid，不能悄悄用更宽的窗口继续。

This basic FM engine constrains counts, not areas. Legal counts can coexist with very unequal areas. Adding area bounds requires checking them after every candidate move and validating the initial assignment.

Change maxDiff in the lab. Widening it can make a high-gain vertex eligible earlier. Tightening it can invalidate the initial split. That result is reported as invalid rather than silently widening the rule.

title: 06 · 关于线性时间的准确说法
06 · Be precise about linear time
text:
经典 FM 的线性 pass 结论依赖相应的增益桶、更新与成本模型。本教学实现按 gain 用 Map 组织候选，但仍扫描合法的未锁定节点，并在事件中保留完整候选表，因此不宣称达到论文的 O(P) pass 界。

这里应验证的是选择逻辑与更新正确性：每步增益等于实际 cut 下降；锁定点不重复；每个试探分组符合人数规则；回退后的 cut 不比 pass 起点大。工程优化不能以删去这些语义为代价。

The classic linear-per-pass result depends on the appropriate bucket structure, update rules and cost model. This teaching implementation indexes gains with a Map but scans legal unlocked vertices and records full candidate tables. It does not claim the paper's O(P) pass bound.

Verify semantic invariants: recorded gain equals actual cut reduction, locks do not repeat, trial assignments obey balance, and prefix acceptance never worsens the pass start. A faster implementation must preserve these properties.

title: 07 · 修正常见混淆
07 · Correct the shorthand
text:
“贪心取最大 gain”应完整写成“在合法未锁定候选中取最大 gain”。“一次移动一个点”也不等于“只接受单步正收益”。KL/FM 共享前缀思想，区别主要在移动对象与合法性。

Python 区实现 move_gain 和 best_prefix，用真实移动前后的 cut 差复核。完成后再看谱方法：它不从候选局部移动出发，而是先用整个图的矩阵结构产生一个节点排序。

“Choose maximum gain” means maximum gain among legal, unlocked candidates. “Move one vertex” does not mean accepting only individually positive moves. KL and FM share the prefix idea while differing in move objects and legality.

Implement move_gain and best_prefix in Python, checking against actual cut changes. Spectral bisection next takes a different approach: use the whole graph's matrix structure to produce an ordering.

title: 01 · 用全图结构产生排序
01 · Use global structure to order vertices
text:
谱方法先把离散分组问题放松成连续坐标问题，让强连接节点的坐标更接近，再把坐标转回分组。本课程使用未归一化拉普拉斯 L=D−A，节点按名称排序；它不是归一化割算法，也不是屏幕中的物理弹簧模拟。

若 x 是节点坐标，xᵀLx=Σ边 w(u,v)(xu−xv)²。权重大而坐标差大的边会带来大能量。常量向量能量为 0，却没有分组信息，所以需要排除常量方向，并固定向量长度，避免用全零解取巧。

Spectral bisection relaxes discrete labels into continuous coordinates, encourages strongly connected vertices to stay close, then converts coordinates back into a split. Here L=D−A is the unnormalized Laplacian. This is neither a normalized-cut implementation nor a physical spring simulation.

For coordinates x, xᵀLx=Σedges w(u,v)(xu−xv)². A heavy edge with widely separated endpoints costs more energy. Constant coordinates have zero energy but no grouping information, so exclude the constant direction and fix the vector length.

title: 02 · 逐边构造矩阵
02 · Build L edge by edge
text:
对边 u–v、权重 w，在 Luu、Lvv 加 w，在 Luv、Lvu 减 w。公共图中 A 的加权度为 6，所以第一行按 A…E 顺序是 [6,−5,−1,0,0]。每行和为 0，矩阵对称，对角线非负。

```text
for each edge (u,v,w):
    L[u,u] += w; L[v,v] += w
    L[u,v] -= w; L[v,u] -= w
```

若把无向邻接表里的两份边都累加，矩阵会整体加倍；虽然某些排序可能不变，特征值与能量已经变了。先核对建模与矩阵，再看最终切割结果。

For u–v of weight w, add w to Luu and Lvv and subtract w from Luv and Lvu. In G01, A has weighted degree 6, giving first row [6,−5,−1,0,0] in A–E order. The matrix is symmetric, has nonnegative diagonal and zero row sums.

```text
for each edge (u,v,w):
    L[u,u] += w; L[v,v] += w
    L[u,v] -= w; L[v,u] -= w
```

Counting both adjacency-list copies doubles the matrix. Some orders may survive, but eigenvalues and energies change. Verify the model before judging the final partition.

title: 03 · Fiedler 向量与数值诊断
03 · The vector and its diagnostics
text:
将特征值从小到大排列。连通图的最小值为 0，对应常量向量；第二小值 λ2 对应的向量称为 Fiedler 向量。页面使用对称 Jacobi 旋转实时求解，同时报告 ‖Lx−λ2x‖/‖x‖、与常量方向的内积及 λ2、λ3 的间隙。

向量 x 与 −x 都合法，翻号只会反转排序方向、交换左右命名。为使结果稳定，本实现让按名称第一个显著非零分量为正。接近相等的分量和平票还需要确定性规则；数值误差不能靠手写一个好看的顺序掩盖。

Sort eigenvalues increasingly. A connected graph has smallest eigenvalue 0 with a constant eigenvector. An eigenvector for the second smallest eigenvalue λ2 is a Fiedler vector. The page solves the symmetric problem live using Jacobi rotations and reports residual ‖Lx−λ2x‖/‖x‖, orthogonality to constants and the λ2–λ3 gap.

Both x and −x are valid. A sign flip reverses the ordering and exchanges side names. To stabilize display, the first significant entry in name order is made positive. Equal entries need deterministic ties; numerical errors should not be hidden behind a hand-authored ordering.

title: 04 · 扫描，而不是只切正负号
04 · Sweep every legal prefix
text:
将节点按向量值升序排列，依次尝试前 1、2…n−1 个节点作为左侧。对每个切口先检查人数窗口，再计算 cut。默认要求每侧至少占 20%；这个比例按节点数计算，界面不会把它称为面积约束。

G01 的排序为 E、D、C、B、A，四个前缀的 cut 为 6、3、5、6。最佳前缀长度为 2，得到 DE | ABC。机械地从序列中间切，或只按正负号切，可能错过更低的合法 cut。

[[interactive]]

Sort vertices by ascending coordinate and try prefixes of lengths 1 through n−1. Check the count window and compute each cut. By default each side needs at least 20% of the vertices. This is a count rule, not an area bound.

G01 orders E,D,C,B,A. Prefix cuts are 6,3,5,6, making length 2 best: DE | ABC. Cutting at the middle or at zero alone can miss the best legal threshold.

[[interactive]]

title: 05 · 断连与重复特征值
05 · Disconnection and repeated eigenvalues
text:
图有多个连通分量时，零特征值也有多个，第二特征向量不唯一。即使图连通，若 λ2=λ3，也可能有多个同样合法的方向。例如四节点等权环的 λ2 与 λ3 都为 2。不同求解器可能给出不同向量，不能仅凭符号或逐项值不同就判错。

诊断区会显示这些警告。检查应结合残差、合法性、能量与最终目标；对非唯一解，不强行要求与某张截图相同。若窗口没有任何合法前缀，引擎报告 infeasible，不用一个违规的中间切口代替。

Multiple connected components produce multiple zero eigenvalues and a non-unique second vector. A connected graph can also have λ2=λ3; the equal-weight four-cycle has both equal to 2. Different valid solvers may return different directions in the same eigenspace.

The lab displays these warnings. Check residual, feasibility, energy and objective rather than demanding identical vector entries or screenshots. If no prefix satisfies the window, report infeasible instead of substituting an illegal midpoint.

title: 06 · 松弛不保证离散最优
06 · A relaxation is not an exact solver
text:
连续坐标只是一种结构提示。排序前缀仅覆盖很小一部分二分，最后还要施加离散和平衡约束。谱二分在 G01 上得到最优 cut=3，不表示它在所有图上全局最优。

小图可以枚举全部合法二分进行对照。若谱结果比精确解大，这不是自动说明数值求解错了；先检查矩阵、残差和约束，再判断它是否只是松弛与舍入造成的差距。

Continuous coordinates provide structural guidance. Prefix cuts cover only a small fraction of discrete assignments, and rounding must still satisfy balance. G01's optimum of 3 does not establish a general guarantee.

A tiny exhaustive search can expose a gap. A worse spectral cut does not by itself imply a numerical bug. First verify the matrix, residual and constraints; then consider the loss introduced by relaxation and rounding.

title: 07 · 实现两个可审查的环节
07 · Implement two auditable stages
text:
Python 区实现 laplacian 和 sweep_cut。前者验证矩阵结构，后者接受明确的节点顺序与人数窗口，返回最佳合法前缀对应的分组。它把数值求解与离散扫描分开，便于分别测试，不要求学生在入门练习中重写整个特征分解器。

下一章会在每个当前分组的诱导子图上重新构造矩阵和排序。不能把全图 Fiedler 顺序裁剪一下，就假装已经重新求解了不同的子问题。

Implement laplacian and sweep_cut in Python. The latter receives an explicit ordering and count window and returns the best legal prefix assignment. Separating numerical solution from discrete sweep makes both testable without requiring a complete eigensolver in an introductory exercise.

Next, recompute the Laplacian and ordering on each induced subgraph. Cropping the full graph's ordering is not the same as solving the new subproblem.

title: 递归二分
Recursive bisection
subtitle: 一刀接一刀，也要记住整张图

summary: 每次选择当前最大组，在其诱导子图上重新二分，记录全图新增割边。
Split the largest current part on its induced subgraph; account for new cuts on the full graph.
author: xingguangyaoyu
hook: 分完两队再分小组，先前的边界还算不算？
When two teams split into smaller teams, do the old boundaries still count?
objectives: 解释非 2 的幂的 k
Handle k that is not a power of two
识别局部平衡与最终容量差异
Separate local balance from final capacity
terms: 诱导子图 / induced subgraph
保留指定节点以及两端都在其中的边。
The chosen vertices and all edges with both endpoints in that set.
叶子 / leaf
当前仍作为一个分组的子问题。
A current part that can still be split.
分裂树 / split tree
记录每个父组如何产生两个子组。
A record of each parent part and its two children.
新增割 / added cut
一次分裂导致的全图 cut 增量。
The increase in full-graph cut caused by a split.
局部约束 / local constraint

A rule for the current split, not a guarantee on every final part.

title: 01 · 用二分器产生 k 个组
01 · Produce k parts using a bisection solver
text:
递归二分反复调用一个二分器，把当前某个组拆成两个，直到组数达到 k。它不要求 k 是 2 的幂：从一个组出发，每成功分裂一次，组数增加 1，因此达到 k 需要 k−1 次分裂。

本课程选择当前节点数最多的组，人数相同取较小组号；在其诱导子图上重新运行谱二分。这里的“最大”按节点数，不按面积。所有节点始终只属于一个当前组，未分裂的组不发生变化。

Recursive bisection repeatedly splits one current part until there are k parts. k need not be a power of two. Starting from one part, each successful split adds one, so reaching k needs k−1 splits.

This course selects the part with the most vertices, breaking ties by smaller label, then runs spectral bisection afresh on its induced subgraph. Largest means count, not area. Every vertex belongs to exactly one current part.

title: 02 · 诱导子图保留哪些边
02 · What belongs in the induced subgraph?
text:
若选中组的节点集合为 S，诱导子图只含 S 中节点，以及两端都在 S 中的边。连接 S 与其他组的边已经是全图割边，不应留在这次局部矩阵里；否则会用不属于子问题的度数改变谱结果。

G01 第一次切成 DE | ABC，cut=3。第二次应在 ABC 的三条边 AB:5、AC:1、BC:4 上求解，而不是继续使用 CD、CE 的度数。子图谱扫描得到 AB | C，新增割为 AC+BC=5，最终 AB | C | DE 的全图 cut 为 8。

For selected vertices S, retain only edges whose endpoints both lie in S. Edges to other parts already contribute to the full-graph cut. Including them in the local degree matrix would change the subproblem.

G01 first splits into DE | ABC with cut 3. The next solver uses only AB:5, AC:1 and BC:4 inside ABC. It splits AB | C, adding AC+BC=5. The final AB | C | DE assignment has full-graph cut 8.

title: 03 · 分裂树与标签
03 · The split tree and labels
text:
一棵分裂树记录父组、左右孩子、局部排序和新增 cut。组号只是身份标签，不是质量分数。左右翻转或重新编号不改变实际分组，比较结果时应先把每组成员排序，再忽略组号做规范化比较。

实验台每次 split 都是真实重算。你可以换图、改边权、调整 k，再回退到任一次分裂。原提交里的预设三组结果在这里由计算产生，不再依赖固定的 ASSIGN/HIST 表。

[[interactive]]

Record each parent, its children, local ordering and added cut. Labels identify parts; they do not measure quality. Swapping side names or renumbering parts leaves the grouping unchanged, so canonical comparisons sort members and ignore labels.

Every split in this lab is recomputed. Change the graph, weights or k and rewind the resulting tree. Results are generated by an algorithm rather than a fixed assignment/history table.

[[interactive]]

title: 04 · 全图 cut 怎样累计
04 · Account for the full cut
text:
一次分裂只把同一个父组内的节点分开。先前跨组的边仍然跨组，因此旧 cut 不会下降；本次新增 cut 恰好是被新边界分开的父组内部边权之和。

G01 到三组的路径是 0→3→8。不能只报告最后一个子图的 cut=5，也不能把先前 cut=3 加到两个孩子各自又计算一遍的边上。最稳妥的检查是每一步都从全图 edges 重新算 cut，再与累计值对照。

这个单调性属于纯分裂构造。后面若允许跨组交换，旧边界可以改变，cut 便可能下降；那已经是另一个改进阶段。

A split only separates vertices within its parent part. Previously crossing edges remain crossing. Therefore pure splitting cannot reduce the old cut; the increment is exactly the parent-internal weight newly separated by this split.

G01 follows 0→3→8. Reporting only the last subgraph cut 5 omits earlier boundaries. Recompute full-graph cut at every event and compare it with the accumulated increments.

This monotonicity belongs to the construction stage. Later cross-part swaps can change old boundaries and reduce cut.

title: 05 · 局部平衡不等于最终容量
05 · Local balance is not final capacity
text:
每次二分可要求两侧各占当前组至少 20% 的节点，但重复这样的局部约束不会自动得到全局均匀的 k 组。例如第一次 3/2、再拆 3 为 2/1，最终为 2/1/2。若节点面积不同，差距还可能更大。

容量 C 是最终各组的面积上限。递归构造结束后应另外检查；不合法就报告 infeasible，而不是保留一个低 cut 并称为成功。为了保证特定最终容量，需要设计考虑剩余组数和面积预算的二分策略，本基础构造不作此保证。

Requiring each child to contain at least 20% of its parent's vertices does not guarantee equally sized final parts. A 3/2 split followed by 2/1 yields counts 2/1/2. Unequal vertex areas can widen the disparity.

Final capacity bounds each part's area and needs a separate check. An infeasible result is not a successful low-cut solution. Guaranteeing a final capacity requires a strategy aware of remaining parts and area budgets; this basic constructor makes no such claim.

title: 06 · 停止与无法继续
06 · Termination and failure
text:
达到 k 个非空组时停止。输入 k 必须不大于节点数。某个选中子图若没有满足人数窗口的前缀，应报告无法合法分裂；不把所有节点随便平分当作一个符合原约束的谱结果。

若最终组数尚小于 k，至少有一个组含多个节点，但所声明的平衡窗口仍可能使它无法分裂。这是约束与策略的结果，需要明确呈现。实验允许调整窗口重新运行，同时保留可复现参数。

Stop at k nonempty parts, with k no larger than the vertex count. If a selected subgraph has no prefix satisfying the declared window, report infeasible rather than silently using an illegal midpoint.

Before reaching k there is a non-singleton part, but the chosen window can still prevent its split. Expose that constraint failure and let the learner deliberately change the parameters.

title: 07 · 实现与后续改进
07 · Implement and refine
text:
Python 区实现 induced_subgraph 与 largest_part。第一个函数应保留原边权，第二个按人数和组号选择分裂对象；界面会展示你选择的子图。二分器本身已在上一章单独验证。

递归二分容易理解、容易复用已有二分器，但一旦某条边在较早阶段被切开，纯分裂阶段无法把两端重新合到一起。下一章加入跨组交换，观察构造结果能否进一步降低 cut，同时维持明确的容量约束。

Implement induced_subgraph and largest_part in Python. Preserve original internal edges and weights; select by count then label. The visualizer shows the subgraph chosen by your functions. The bisection solver was examined separately in Lesson 6.

Recursive bisection reuses a simple solver, but pure splitting cannot reunite endpoints separated earlier. The next lesson adds legal cross-part exchanges to test whether construction can be improved.

objectives: 比较递归构造与交换改进
Compare recursive construction and swap refinement
解释局部最优和精确解差距
设计同输入的公平比较
terms: k 路 / k-way
把节点划分到 k 个互斥非空组。
Assign vertices to k disjoint, nonempty parts.
轮转 / round robin
第 i 个节点分到 i mod k。
Assign vertex i to i mod k.
交换改进 / swap refinement
每步执行一个严格正增益且容量合法的跨组交换。
Accept a strictly improving, capacity-legal cross-part swap.
局部最优 / local optimum
当前邻域中没有改进，不等于全局最优。
No improvement in the chosen neighborhood; not a global guarantee.
精确枚举 / exact oracle
小图枚举全部合法分组，用于校准与验证。
Enumerate legal tiny assignments for calibration and tests.

title: 01 · k 路目标仍是同一个 edge-cut
01 · The k-way objective
text:
k 路划分将节点完整地放入 k 个互斥非空组。对普通图，一条边只要两端组号不同，就贡献一次边权，不因为 k 增大而重复计费。输入、目标和容量相同，才有可比性。

本章比较三种明确的方法：按节点顺序轮转；按最大组递归谱二分；先递归构造，再做容量合法的跨组交换。第三种称为 swap refinement，不称作完整多路 FM，因为它的邻域与接受规则不同。

Assign every vertex to one of k disjoint, nonempty parts. In an ordinary graph, an edge contributes its weight once whenever endpoint labels differ. Increasing k does not multiply that charge. Meaningful comparison requires the same input, objective and capacity.

We compare input-order round robin, largest-part recursive spectral bisection, and recursive construction followed by capacity-legal swaps. The last is called swap refinement, not full k-way FM: its neighborhood and acceptance rules differ.

title: 02 · 轮转作为基线
02 · A round-robin baseline
text:
将按输入顺序排列的第 i 个节点放入 i mod k 组。G01 在 k=3 时得到 AD | BE | C；六条边全都跨组，cut=18。人数分布 2/2/1 很均匀，却没有利用边权，说明人数公平与连接质量是不同维度。

这个结果与节点顺序有关。比较页明确使用同一输入顺序，不通过偷偷重排节点来让某个基线更好。若改成按名称排序，应把这项变化记录为方法的一部分。

Assign input vertex i to i mod k. At k=3, G01 becomes AD | BE | C. Every edge crosses, so cut=18. Counts 2/2/1 are even, but the method ignores weights. Balanced counts and good connections are separate properties.

The baseline depends on input order. Comparisons preserve that order. Sorting vertices first would define a different method and should be stated rather than silently used to improve a result.

title: 03 · 递归构造的结果
03 · Recursive construction
text:
递归方法先把 G01 分成 DE | ABC，再把 ABC 分成 AB | C，得到 AB | C | DE，cut=8。它保留 AB 和 DE 两条重边，不再切断所有连接。人数仍是 2/1/2，单位面积、容量 2 时合法。

如果给 A 的面积加大，这个分组可能超过容量。构造器不会自动知道最终容量需求；本章先检查它是否可行，再决定是否进入交换阶段。不合法时显示 infeasible，而不是在一个违规起点上继续优化并掩盖问题。

[[interactive]]

Recursive splitting gives DE | ABC, then AB | C, yielding AB | C | DE with cut 8. It preserves the heavy AB and DE edges. Counts are 2/1/2, so unit areas satisfy capacity 2.

Increasing A's area can invalidate the same grouping. The constructor does not automatically account for final capacity. Check feasibility before refinement and report failure instead of hiding an illegal start behind a low objective.

[[interactive]]

title: 04 · 跨组交换改进
04 · Cross-part swap refinement
text:
枚举位于不同组的节点对，假设交换它们的组号。先检查所有组面积不超过 capacity，再算 gain=cut_before−cut_after。选择严格正增益最大的合法交换，平票按节点名；更新后重复，直到没有正增益合法交换或达到步数上限。

交换保持每组人数，面积则会随节点尺寸改变。这个邻域不包含单点移动，也没有 KL/FM 的整轮负增益试探与最佳前缀。因此它可能停在一个无法通过单次交换改善的状态，却还存在其他更好的分组。

在默认 G01、k=3、容量 2 下，递归结果 cut=8 已没有改进交换，交换阶段保持 8。不要为了让动画热闹而添加一条并不存在的改进轨迹；“没有合法正增益动作”本身也是需要解释的算法结果。

Enumerate pairs in different parts. Hypothetically exchange their labels, check every area against capacity, then compute gain=cut_before−cut_after. Accept the largest strictly positive legal gain, breaking ties by vertex names. Repeat until none exists or the step limit is reached.

Swaps preserve counts but can change areas. This neighborhood contains neither single-node moves nor a full pass of negative-gain trials and best-prefix rollback. It can stop even when another neighborhood could improve the solution.

Default G01 at k=3 and capacity 2 has no improving swap from cut 8. The correct trace therefore stays at 8. A useful explanation can show why nothing improves; it should not invent motion to make an animation busier.

title: 05 · 用小图精确解校准
05 · Calibrate with an exact tiny solver
text:
精确枚举检查每个合法非空分组，忽略组号置换造成的重复。G01、k=3、容量 2 的最优 cut 为 8，与递归结果相同。这只证明这一小实例达到最优，不提供启发式的一般保证。

页面的精确 oracle 最多支持 9 个节点、4 个组，防止指数搜索冻结浏览器。实验引擎支持更大的小型教学输入，但超过 oracle 限制就跳过精确比较，并写明原因。不能把未计算的最优值显示成 0。

The oracle enumerates legal nonempty assignments while removing duplicate part-label permutations. For G01, k=3 and capacity 2, its optimum is 8. Agreement proves optimality only for that instance.

The browser oracle supports at most 9 vertices and 4 parts because the search is exponential. Larger teaching inputs can still run heuristics, while exact comparison is explicitly skipped. An uncomputed optimum must not appear as zero.

title: 06 · 改边权，观察方法是否响应
06 · Change a weight and rerun
text:
把 AB 权重从 5 改为 1，再运行相同 k=3 的比较。轮转仍切开全部边，cut 从 18 变为 14；谱排序与递归分组会重新求解，可能换成 A | BC | DE、cut=5。请以页面实际事件为准，注意相等特征值或平票可能存在等价分组。

这个实验检查的是算法是否真正依赖输入。一个只播放预设帧的演示会继续给出旧答案，无法完成同图对照。你还可以改变容量、节点面积或 k，分别观察目标与可行性如何变化。

Change AB from 5 to 1 at k=3. Round robin still cuts every edge, reducing its cost from 18 to 14. The spectral and recursive methods solve again and can produce A | BC | DE with cut 5. Inspect actual events; ties or repeated eigenvalues may permit equivalent groupings.

This checks whether the method responds to its input. A canned sequence cannot support the same experiment. Also vary capacity, sizes and k to separate objective changes from feasibility changes.

title: 07 · 给出可复现的比较结论
07 · Report a reproducible comparison
text:
一个完整比较应记录图、节点顺序、面积、k、容量、构造策略、平票规则、停止原因、最终 cut 和各组面积。若某行不可行，不把它与合法结果一起按 cut 排名。若精确解存在，再报告 gap；没有精确解就保留未知。

Python 区实现 round_robin 与 swap_gain，页面用你返回的分组和增益可视化。完成七章后，应能用同一个评价器解释构造、改进和全局结构方法的区别，也能说清每一种“成功”结论的约束边界。

Record the graph, vertex order, sizes, k, capacity, construction strategy, ties, stop reason, final cut and part areas. Do not rank infeasible rows alongside feasible ones by cost. Report an optimality gap only when an exact result is available.

Implement round_robin and swap_gain in Python. The visualizer uses your returned assignment and gain. Across the seven lessons, one evaluator connects construction, local refinement and global structural methods while keeping each conclusion's assumptions explicit.
